title: THERE is no friend like Jesus

lines.text: THERE is no friend like Jesus
Christ our Lord
He is our only faithful friend
Worldly Friend deny Worldly
Friend desert But Jesus will
never forget me.
Ah! never forget me
Ah never forget me
But Jesus will never forget me.
Let us wait the Lord let us never
doubt
Whatever may come thither your way
When your hope is lost,
His help will come
A wonderful God is our God.
All Ye Elders and All Ye praying Band
And all workers in the Holy Band
The Great Judge is quickly coming now
There will be no excuse on that day.
All ye members of native choral Band
And the universal Choral band
The Saviour cometh, His reward to share
Eversure He will not forget me.
Your faith will one-day be put to test
Ye Cherub and Seraph of the world
With Fire your faith may be on test
Who ever fail will have no reward.
Glory be to God to Father and Son
Glory be to the Holy Spirit
Glory be to the Holy Trinity
It is sure He will not forget me.
